detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Fear me mortals, for I am the Anointed, the Favoured Son of Chaos, the Scourge of the World. The armies of the gods rally behind me, and it is by my will and by my sword that your weakling nations shall fall.
- Archaon, lord of the End Times

AN EPIC BATTLE RAGES FOLLOWING A CHAOS INVASION, THREATENING THE REALMS OF THE EMPIRE

The Warhammer World is fraught with foul energy, torn apart by raging battles, and condemned to an eternal war. The world is constantly on the verge of destruction. It is a dark age, an age of blood.

People have to share the world with horrible and deadly creatures, while the dark Hordes of Chaos are approaching from the North. Green-skinned, brutal and war-hungry Orcs and Goblins are invading the Empire.

Beneath the earth’s surface live the rat-like Skaven with their desire for the decay of the high and mighty of the world whilst the unscrupulous Dark Elf warriors have set off from the lands beyond the Great Ocean.

MAKE YOUR MARK

Warhammer: Mark of Chaos Gold Edition includes both the successful Mark of Chaos and the official add-on Mark of Chaos: Battle March in a single package.

Decide your own tactics, appearance, and army setup. Lead the Empire, the Hordes of Chaos, Orcs & Goblins, Dark Elves, High Elves, or Skaven across three single-player campaigns and skirmish battles.

WHAT’S INSIDE THIS RELEASE

This edition updates Warhammer: Mark of Chaos to run smoothly on modern Windows systems. The game’s UI now scales properly up to 4K resolution, with support for widescreen displays. Stability has been improved, loading times have been reduced, and additional fixes have been applied. Hungarian text localization has also been added, and Steam Cloud saves are now supported.

PLEASE NOTE: Multiplayer supports LAN only.

FEATURES

  • Master the art of war and take control of six unique Warhammer armies across three dramatic campaigns - the Empire, Hordes of Chaos, Skaven, High Elves, Dark Elves and Orcs & Goblins

  • Create your army from over 100 diverse units true to the Warhammer World

  • Fight epic-scale battles where towering daemons and intricately detailed battalions clash with thousands of characters on screen

  • Customize units with body part swaps, weapon and armour upgrades, detailed unit painting, and banner customization

  • Hone your Heroes into fearsome warriors and challenge enemy Champions in duels to the death

  • Immerse yourself in the grim world of Warhammer Fantasy with detailed visuals and an epic soundtrack

WARHAMMER CLASSICS

Warhammer Classics is a collection of the greatest titles from the annals of Warhammer video game history, spanning the last 30 years, brought back to life as a series to celebrate their iconic legacy. These games have been revived in their original state. Because of their classic nature, some of the content may not accurately reflect current depictions, lore, or presentation within the current Warhammer universes and settings.
